---
title: "Colocalization Explorer"
subtitle: "Filter by locus and dataset family. Bubble size = PP.H4; color = significant (PP.H4 > 0.8)."
format:
  html:
    page-layout: full
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r setup}
pkgs <- c("data.table", "stringr", "plotly", "crosstalk", "htmlwidgets")
to_install <- setdiff(pkgs, rownames(installed.packages()))
if (length(to_install) > 0) install.packages(to_install, repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org")
library(data.table); library(stringr); library(plotly); library(crosstalk); library(htmlwidgets)

THR <- 0.8

d <- fread("data/coloc_all_annotated.csv")
d[is.na(gene_symbol) | gene_symbol == "", gene_symbol := gene_clean]
d[, gene_symbol := str_remove(as.character(gene_symbol), ";.*$")]
d[, region_chr := as.character(region_chr)]

# splice_id só existe se o aggregate_coloc.R já foi reprocessado com a
# correção que preserva o id original do evento de sQTL. Se não existir,
# cria como NA -- sem isso o fifelse() abaixo quebra, porque ele avalia os
# dois ramos inteiros antes de escolher (não é lazy como um if comum).
if (!"splice_id" %in% names(d)) d[, splice_id := NA_character_]

d[, family := fcase(
  str_detect(dataset, regex("^gtex_", ignore_case = TRUE)),        "GTEx",
  str_detect(dataset, regex("^bigbrain_", ignore_case = TRUE)),    "BigBrain",
  str_detect(dataset, regex("^devbrain_", ignore_case = TRUE)),    "DevBrain",
  str_detect(dataset, regex("^singlebrain_", ignore_case = TRUE)), "SingleBrain",
  default = "Other")]

simplify_label <- function(dataset, family) {
  lbl <- str_remove(dataset, regex("^(gtex_|bigbrain_|devbrain_|singlebrain_)", ignore_case = TRUE))
  lbl <- ifelse(family == "GTEx", str_remove(lbl, regex("^Brain_", ignore_case = TRUE)), lbl)
  str_replace_all(lbl, "_", " ")
}
d[, dataset_label := simplify_label(dataset, family)]

# 1 linha por (locus, gene, dataset): a própria linha do PP.H4 máximo --
# ties.method = "first" é essencial aqui. O padrão do frank() é "average",
# que dá rank 1.5 (não 1) quando duas linhas empatam no valor máximo -- e
# nesse caso `rk == 1` não bate com nada, derrubando o grupo inteiro do
# plot sem erro nem aviso.
d[, rk := frank(-PP.H4, ties.method = "first"), by = .(locus, gene_symbol, dataset)]
plot_dt <- d[rk == 1]

keep <- plot_dt[PP.H4 > THR, .(locus, gene_symbol)]
plot_dt <- merge(plot_dt, unique(keep), by = c("locus", "gene_symbol"))
plot_dt[, significativo := fifelse(PP.H4 > THR, "Yes", "No")]

plot_dt[, regional_file := fifelse(
  significativo == "Yes",
  paste0(dataset, "_",
         fifelse(str_detect(dataset, "_sqtl$") & !is.na(splice_id), splice_id, gene_raw),
         "_", region_chr, "_", region_start, "_", region_end, "_regional.png"),
  NA_character_
)]

plot_dt[, ct_key := paste(locus, gene_symbol, dataset)]

sd <- SharedData$new(plot_dt, key = ~ct_key, group = "explorer")

# Mapa key -> (categoria x, categoria y) usado pelo JS para recalcular quais
# linhas/colunas devem existir no eixo depois de cada filtro do crosstalk.
# Sem isso o plotly mantém as categorias originais e sobram linhas/colunas vazias.
axis_map <- list(
  keys = plot_dt$ct_key,
  xs   = plot_dt$dataset_label,
  ys   = plot_dt$gene_symbol,
  allX = sort(unique(plot_dt$dataset_label)),
  allY = sort(unique(plot_dt$gene_symbol))
)
```

::: {.panel-sidebar}
```{r filtros}
bscols(
  widths = 12,
  filter_select("locus_f", "Locus", sd, ~locus, multiple = TRUE),
  filter_checkbox("fam_f", "Dataset family", sd, ~family, inline = TRUE)
)
```

Tip: start typing the name of a locus (ex. `BIN1`, `KAT8`) — the plot is only legible with 1 to 3 loci selected.
:::

::: {.panel-fill}
```{r plot}
#| fig-height: 9

p <- plot_ly(sd, x = ~dataset_label, y = ~gene_symbol,
             size = ~PP.H4, sizes = c(20, 400),
             color = ~significativo, colors = c("Yes" = "#1F6FB4", "No" = "#C8C8C8"),
             customdata = ~regional_file,
             text = ~paste0("<b>", locus, " | ", gene_symbol, "</b><br>",
                            dataset, "<br>PP.H4 = ", round(PP.H4, 3)),
             hoverinfo = "text", type = "scatter", mode = "markers") |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = NULL, tickangle = -45, categoryorder = "array",
                 categoryarray = sort(unique(plot_dt$dataset_label))),
    yaxis = list(title = NULL, categoryorder = "array",
                 categoryarray = sort(unique(plot_dt$gene_symbol))),
    legend = list(title = list(text = "PP.H4 > 0.8")),
    margin = list(b = 140)
  )

p <- htmlwidgets::onRender(p, "
  function(el, x, data) {

    // key -> [dataset_label, gene_symbol]
    var map = {};
    for (var i = 0; i < data.keys.length; i++) {
      map[data.keys[i]] = [data.xs[i], data.ys[i]];
    }

    function applyAxes(keys) {
      var xs, ys;
      if (!keys || keys.length === 0) {
        xs = data.allX;
        ys = data.allY;
      } else {
        var seenX = {}, seenY = {};
        keys.forEach(function(k) {
          var v = map[k];
          if (v) { seenX[v[0]] = true; seenY[v[1]] = true; }
        });
        xs = data.allX.filter(function(v) { return seenX[v]; });
        ys = data.allY.filter(function(v) { return seenY[v]; });
        if (xs.length === 0 || ys.length === 0) { xs = data.allX; ys = data.allY; }
      }
      Plotly.relayout(el, {
        'xaxis.categoryorder': 'array', 'xaxis.categoryarray': xs,
        'yaxis.categoryorder': 'array', 'yaxis.categoryarray': ys
      });
    }

    // O crosstalk dispara o 'change' antes do plotly terminar de reescrever os
    // traces; o setTimeout garante que o relayout aconteça depois do restyle.
    if (window.crosstalk) {
      var fh = new crosstalk.FilterHandle('explorer');
      fh.on('change', function(e) {
        setTimeout(function() { applyAxes(e.value); }, 30);
      });
    }

    el.on('plotly_click', function(d) {
      var fn = d.points[0].customdata;
      var img = document.getElementById('regional-img');
      var cap = document.getElementById('regional-caption');
      if (!fn) { cap.innerText = 'No regional plot (not significant).'; img.style.display='none'; return; }
      img.src = 'data/regional_plots/' + fn;
      img.style.display = 'block';
      img.onerror = function() { cap.innerText = 'File not found: ' + fn; img.style.display='none'; };
      img.onload = function() { cap.innerText = fn; };
    });
  }
", data = axis_map)
p
```

```{r img-panel}
htmltools::div(
  htmltools::tags$img(id = "regional-img", style = "max-width:100%; display:none; margin-top:12px;"),
  htmltools::tags$p(id = "regional-caption", style = "color:#666; font-size:0.85rem;")
)
```
